# SmartObjects

27 tools. Back to the [index](README.md).

## `add_smart_object_definition_default_behavior`

*Additive.*

Attach a definition-level default behavior (applied to slots without their own) to a USmartObjectDefinition; the private DefaultBehaviorDefinitions array is reached via FArrayProperty reflection.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Path to the USmartObjectDefinition asset |
| `behavior_class` | string | yes | Behavior class: short native name or /Script path; must derive from USmartObjectBehaviorDefinition |

**Returns:** `{ definition_path: string, behavior_class: string, default_behavior_count: int, added: bool, saved: bool }`

## `add_smart_object_slot`

*Additive, idempotent.*

Append a named activity slot to a USmartObjectDefinition (idempotent on name).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Path to the USmartObjectDefinition asset |
| `slot_name` | string | yes | Unique name for the new slot |
| `activity_tag` | string | no | Optional FGameplayTag to attach to the slot; defaults to "Default" |

**Returns:** `{ definition_path: string, slot_name: string, activity_tag: string, slot_count: int, added?: bool, already_existed?: bool, saved: bool }`

## `add_smart_object_slot_behavior_definition`

*Additive.*

Attach a behavior definition (class resolved by name) to a slot of a USmartObjectDefinition. The class must derive from USmartObjectBehaviorDefinition (e.g. GameplayBehaviorSmartObjectBehaviorDefinition). A behavior on every slot (or a default) makes the definition Validate()-valid.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Path to the USmartObjectDefinition asset |
| `behavior_class` | string | yes | Behavior class: short native name (e.g. "GameplayBehaviorSmartObjectBehaviorDefinition") or full /Script path |
| `slot_index` | number | no | Index of the slot to attach the behavior to |

**Returns:** `{ definition_path: string, slot_index: int, behavior_class: string, behavior_count: int, saved: bool }`

## `add_smart_object_slot_entrance_annotation`

*Additive.*

Add an entrance (entry/exit point) annotation to a slot of a USmartObjectDefinition, including its navigation/trajectory fields.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Path to the USmartObjectDefinition asset |
| `slot_index` | number | no | Index of the slot to add the entrance to |
| `offset` | array | no | Optional [x, y, z] local-space offset of the entrance |
| `rotation` | array | no | Optional [pitch, yaw, roll] local-space rotation (degrees) |
| `is_entry` | boolean | no | Optional: entrance can be used to enter the slot (default true) |
| `is_exit` | boolean | no | Optional: entrance can be used to exit the slot (default true) |
| `tags` | array | no | Optional gameplay tag names identifying the entrance |
| `trace_ground_location` | boolean | no | Optional: adjust ground location with a line trace (default true). |
| `check_transition_trajectory` | boolean | no | Optional: check collisions on the transition from nav location to slot (default false). |
| `selection_priority` | string | no | Optional entrance selection priority: Lowest\|Lower\|Low\|BelowNormal\|Normal\|AboveNormal\|High\|Higher\|Highest (default Normal). |
| `trajectory_start_height_offset` | number | no | Optional height offset at the start of the transition check (default 80). |
| `trajectory_slot_height_offset` | number | no | Optional height offset at the slot for the transition check (default 40). |
| `transition_check_radius` | number | no | Optional radius of the transition trajectory check (default 10). |

**Returns:** `{ definition_path: string, slot_index: int, entrance_count: int, data_count: int, saved: bool }`

## `claim_smart_object`

*Destructive.*

Claim a free slot on the Smart Object component of an actor in the editor world. Returns the canonical claim_handle (LexToString) for downstream release.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_label` | string | yes | Editor label of the actor carrying the USmartObjectComponent |
| `definition_path` | string | no | Optional path to the definition; only used for reporting |

**Returns:** `{ actor_label: string, definition_path: string, claim_handle: string, slot_id: string, is_claimed: bool, success: bool }`

## `create_smart_object_definition`

*Additive.*

Create (or load) a USmartObjectDefinition asset and seed it with N activity slots via the public DebugAddSlot API.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_name` | string | yes | Name for the new Smart Object definition |
| `package_path` | string | no | Content folder; defaults to /Game/MCP |
| `num_activity_slots` | number | no | Number of slots to add; defaults to 1 |

**Returns:** `{ definition_path: string, definition_name: string, num_slots: int, created: bool, saved: bool }`

## `find_smart_objects`

*Read-only.*

Spatially query the SmartObject subsystem for slots within a box centered on a point (USmartObjectSubsystem::FindSmartObjects). HONEST GATE: the spatial index only populates once the subsystem runtime is initialized (BeginPlay/PIE); in the editor/headless world it is empty, so this returns success with an empty results list and a note rather than fabricating hits.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `center` | array | yes | [x, y, z] world-space center of the search box |
| `radius` | number | yes | Half-extent (uu) of the AABB search box around center |
| `include_claimed` | boolean | no | Optional: also return already-claimed slots (default false) |
| `include_disabled` | boolean | no | Optional: also return disabled slots (default false) |

**Returns:** `{ center: [number, number, number], radius: number, results: [{ object_handle: string, slot_handle: string, actor_label: string }], count: int, note?: string }`

## `register_smart_object_actor`

*Additive.*

Spawn an empty actor in the editor world, attach a USmartObjectComponent pointing at the given definition, and register it with USmartObjectSubsystem. Note: the definition must already have a behavior definition (per-slot or default) or the subsystem silently rejects the handle (see handle_valid).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_label` | string | yes | Editor label for the new actor |
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Path to the USmartObjectDefinition asset |
| `location` | array | no | Optional [x, y, z] world location; defaults to (0,0,0) |

**Returns:** `{ actor_label: string, actor_name: string, definition_path: string, has_component: bool, registered: bool, handle_valid: bool }`

## `release_smart_object`

*Destructive.*

Release a Smart Object claim. The only headless-safe path is to pass actor_label so the subsystem can unregister the component (which releases any claim it holds). FSmartObjectUserHandle is private in UE 5.7, so a claim_handle-only path is not possible without a C++ extension.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_label` | string | no | Optional editor label of the actor whose component to unregister (releases all its claims) |
| `claim_handle` | string | no | Optional canonical claim string; documented limitation: round-trip is not public in 5.7 |

**Returns:** `{ actor_label: string, released: bool } | (error: "release_smart_object: ...")`

## `remove_smart_object_definition_default_behavior`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Remove a definition-level default behavior (by index) from a USmartObjectDefinition; the private DefaultBehaviorDefinitions array is reached via FArrayProperty reflection and resized through FScriptArrayHelper. Idempotent: a behavior_index past the end returns already_absent without error.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Path to the USmartObjectDefinition asset |
| `behavior_index` | number | no | Index into DefaultBehaviorDefinitions to remove |

**Returns:** `{ definition_path: string, behavior_index: int, default_behavior_count: int, removed: bool, already_absent: bool, saved: bool }`

## `remove_smart_object_slot`

*Destructive.*

Remove the slot at slot_index from a USmartObjectDefinition asset, together with its behaviors, tags and annotations; later slots shift down one index, so re-read indices with get_smart_object_slots_detail. Saves the asset; a failed save returns an error with the removal kept in memory. An invalid slot_index is an error. No undo. To turn a slot off while keeping indices stable use set_smart_object_slot_enabled; add_smart_object_slot appends one.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Path to the USmartObjectDefinition asset |
| `slot_index` | number | no | Index of the slot to remove |

**Returns:** `{ definition_path: string, slot_index: int, slot_count: int, removed: bool, saved: bool }`

## `remove_smart_object_slot_behavior_definition`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Remove a behavior definition from a slot of a USmartObjectDefinition by its index in the slot's BehaviorDefinitions array. Idempotent: a behavior_index past the end returns already_absent without error.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Path to the USmartObjectDefinition asset. |
| `slot_index` | number | no | Index of the slot to edit. |
| `behavior_index` | number | no | Index into the slot's BehaviorDefinitions to remove. |

**Returns:** `{ definition_path: string, slot_index: int, behavior_index: int, behavior_count: int, removed: bool, already_absent: bool, saved: bool }`

## `remove_smart_object_slot_entrance_annotation`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Remove an entrance annotation (by its index among the slot's entrance annotations) from a slot of a USmartObjectDefinition. entrance_index counts only FSmartObjectSlotEntranceAnnotation entries in the slot's DefinitionData (mirror of add_smart_object_slot_entrance_annotation, inverted). Idempotent: an entrance_index past the number of entrances returns already_absent without error.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Path to the USmartObjectDefinition asset |
| `slot_index` | number | no | Index of the slot to edit |
| `entrance_index` | number | no | Index among the slot's entrance annotations to remove (0-based; entrances only, not all definition data) |

**Returns:** `{ definition_path: string, slot_index: int, entrance_index: int, entrance_count: int, data_count: int, removed: bool, already_absent: bool, saved: bool }`

## `set_smart_object_slot_enabled`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set the authored enabled flag (bEnabled) of the slot at slot_index in a USmartObjectDefinition asset, then save it: the initial state that smart objects built from this definition start with. enabled defaults to true when omitted. An invalid slot_index is an error, and a failed save returns an error with the change kept in memory. No undo. Use remove_smart_object_slot to delete the slot instead, and get_smart_object_slots_detail to read slots back.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Path to the USmartObjectDefinition asset |
| `slot_index` | number | no | Index of the slot to edit |
| `enabled` | boolean | no | Whether the slot is enabled |

**Returns:** `{ definition_path: string, slot_index: int, enabled: bool, saved: bool }`

## `set_smart_object_slot_runtime_tags`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Replace a slot's initial runtime tags (FGameplayTagContainer) on a USmartObjectDefinition, addressed by slot_index. Tags not registered in the project are skipped.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Path to the USmartObjectDefinition asset. |
| `slot_index` | number | no | Index of the slot to edit. |
| `runtime_tags` | array | no | Gameplay tag names to set as the slot's runtime tags. |

**Returns:** `{ definition_path: string, slot_index: int, runtime_tags: [string], saved: bool }`

## `set_smart_object_slot_transform`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set the local offset and/or rotation (degrees) of the slot at slot_index in a USmartObjectDefinition asset, relative to the smart object's owner, then save it. Each of offset and rotation is written only when given with 3 numbers; otherwise it keeps its value. An invalid slot_index is an error, and a failed save returns an error with the change kept in memory. No undo. Read slots back with get_smart_object_slots_detail; set_smart_object_slot_enabled and set_smart_object_slot_activity_tags edit other slot fields.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Path to the USmartObjectDefinition asset |
| `slot_index` | number | no | Index of the slot to edit |
| `offset` | array | no | Optional [x, y, z] local offset |
| `rotation` | array | no | Optional [pitch, yaw, roll] local rotation (degrees) |

**Returns:** `{ definition_path: string, slot_index: int, offset: [number, number, number], rotation: [number, number, number], saved: bool }`

## `use_smart_object`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Claim a free slot on an actor's SmartObject component and immediately mark it occupied (USmartObjectSubsystem::MarkSlotAsOccupied), driving a behavior definition. Single-call claim+occupy keyed by actor_label (an FSmartObjectClaimHandle cannot be rebuilt from a string, so a two-step claim_handle path is impossible). HONEST GATE: the component handle only registers once the subsystem runtime is initialized (PIE/BeginPlay); headless it is invalid and this returns a clean error. Idempotent: an already-occupied slot returns already_occupied without re-occupying.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_label` | string | yes | Editor label of the actor carrying the USmartObjectComponent |
| `behavior_class` | string | no | Optional behavior definition class (short native name or /Script path); defaults to USmartObjectBehaviorDefinition |

**Returns:** `{ actor_label: string, slot_id: string, behavior_definition: string, is_occupied: bool, already_occupied: bool, success: bool }`
